_comment: Golden vectors for the signed BODIES the server verifies. Generated from backend/auth.py, asserted by backend/tests/test_signed_bodies.py and by packages/crypto-core/test/byte-compat.test.js. Both sides must build these byte-for-byte or the signature fails; the point of a shared fixture is that neither side can be the one that is right. The message inputs are short stand-ins on purpose — the body interpolates them verbatim, so a realistic 2624-char address would only make the vector unreadable without testing anything more.
